pages.title: Quantum Random Number Chip
pages.text: Single photons meet a half-silvered mirror: transmitted is 1, reflected is 0. Nothing in the universe knows the next bit in advance.

Made in $(item)Monte Carlo Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Crashed Satellite, Derelict Station, Probability Hall chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Monte Carlo Methods.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Atomic Clock, Bayesian Analyzer, Markov Chain Link, Prior Tablet, Satellite Wreck, Stochastic Core, Transition Valve.
